annotations.description: Mulliganed a functional 7-card hand with 3 mana sources (2 lands + Ash Barrens), a turn-1 play (Lightning-Core Excavator), premium removal (Lightning Bolt), and a curve-topper (Lightning Elemental). While Titan's Presence is nearly dead, the rest of the hand is solid for a Limited deck.
annotations.betterLine: Keep the 7-card hand. It has early plays, removal, and a reasonable mana base. Going to 6 risks getting a worse hand and being down a card.

annotations.description: Thriving Bluff's color choice timed out, likely defaulting to White instead of Green. MstLg Villain is playing a R/G deck with Unnatural Aggression and Forest in hand, and needs green mana. White is completely useless for this deck. Having Thriving Bluff produce green would provide valuable color fixing, especially important since they only have 2 Mountains and 1 Forest for lands so far.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out on Thriving Bluff color choice, likely defaulting to White (a useless color for this R/G deck).
annotations.betterLine: Choose Green for Thriving Bluff to have access to both red and green mana, supporting cards like Unnatural Aggression and other green spells in the deck.

annotations.description: Cast Unnatural Aggression before playing Forest from hand. While the spell can be cast either way, playing the land first is strictly better sequencing - it leaves an extra untapped land available and preserves options. The fight itself (Lightning Visionary trading with King of the Pride) is a reasonable 1-for-1 trade removing an opponent's lord.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Unnatural Aggression before playing the Forest land drop.
annotations.betterLine: Play Forest first, then cast Unnatural Aggression. This leaves an additional untapped land available, which could matter for bluffing or unexpected interactions.

annotations.description: Cast Lightning Axe targeting a 1/1 Elvish Rejuvenator, which requires discarding either Lightning Diadem or Lightning Elemental as additional cost. This is a 2-for-1 trade to kill a nearly irrelevant 1/1 body that already got its ETB value. The discarded card (likely Lightning Elemental or Lightning Diadem) has far more value than removing a 1/1.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Lightning Axe to kill Elvish Rejuvenator 1/1, discarding a meaningful card from hand
annotations.betterLine: Hold Lightning Axe for a more threatening target. Wait until you have 6 mana to pay the {5} alternative cost, or save it for when the opponent plays a real threat. A 1/1 is not worth spending two cards to remove.

annotations.description: Blocked Lightning Elemental (4/1) with Ingenious Leonin (4/4), trading away a premium 5-mana creature. The 4 damage from Lightning Elemental kills the 4-toughness Leonin, resulting in a mutual trade. Blocking Lightning Visionary (2/1) instead would have preserved the Leonin while only taking 4 more damage (going to 14 instead of 16).
annotations.actionTaken: Blocked Lightning Elemental with Ingenious Leonin, trading a 5-mana 4/4 with an activated ability for a 4/1 hasty creature, taking 2 from unblocked Visionary.
annotations.betterLine: Block Lightning Visionary with Ingenious Leonin. Leonin survives at 4/4 (takes 2 damage), Visionary dies, take 4 from Lightning Elemental. Preserves the Leonin which has excellent synergy with Basri's Acolyte in hand and provides a strong board presence.

annotations.description: Failed to block Stalking Drone 2/2 with Basri's Acolyte 2/3 (lifelink). Blocking would kill the Drone, gain 2 life, and the Acolyte survives as a 2/1. Instead, took 2 damage unnecessarily and left the Drone alive. The opponent had no colorless mana to pump the Drone, and only 2 mana open making combat tricks unlikely to change the outcome significantly.
annotations.actionTaken: No response (timed out) - did not block, taking 2 damage from Stalking Drone.
annotations.betterLine: Block Stalking Drone with Basri's Acolyte to kill the Drone, gain 2 life from lifelink, and keep the Acolyte alive as a 2/1. This is a 4-point life swing (2 damage prevented + 2 life gained) plus removing a creature.
